description: This file defines an Android Activity class, OpenGLWatchFaceConfigActivity, which serves as a configuration activity for a watch face service. It primarily sets a layout and updates a TextView with the component name of the watch face.

classes.name: OpenGLWatchFaceConfigActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity class that serves as a configuration UI for a watch face service, displaying the component name.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created, sets up the layout and updates the label with the watch face component name.
